case.title: Change reminder timing
case.text: Hey, reminders go out 24h before but my clients forget anyway. Can I send one 2 hours before too?
case.why: Reminder timing how-to (up to three reminders per appointment).

output.reply:
Hi Lucas, yes, you can! Slotwise lets you add up to three reminders per appointment, so a 24-hour reminder plus a 2-hour reminder works well.

Here's how:
1. Go to Settings → Reminders.
2. Choose your channel: SMS, WhatsApp, or SMS + WhatsApp.
3. In the timing section, add a second reminder set to 2 hours before.
4. Edit the message template if you like, then click Save.

New and existing future appointments will use the new settings. Keep in mind that SMS and WhatsApp reminders use message credits, and you can check your balance in Settings → Billing → Message credits. If credits run out, reminders pause until you top up.

Slotwise Support
